Note exhaust air is routed through ducts rather than pipes and therefore do not have assigned schedules. Pipe cost is based on the total mass of the pipe. Larger pipes cost more per unit length, but there tends to be more total length for smaller pipes. The largest pipes nonetheless cost the most overall because of the higher per unit length expense of larger-diameter pipes. 26 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies at www.nlr.gov/publications.
